articles.title: Kraft Heinz and Employers Sue UnitedHealth Over Alleged Claims Mishandling
articles.summary: Major self-funded employers, including Kraft Heinz, have filed a lawsuit against UnitedHealth alleging improper handling of health claims. This legal action highlights growing fiduciary scrutiny by plan sponsors over payer and PBM administrative practices. Self-funded employers are increasingly holding health plans and benefit managers accountable for transparency and claims accuracy.

articles.title: Manufacturer Claims Data Demands Threaten 340B Pricing Integrity
articles.summary: Drug manufacturer demands for claims data are putting 340B pricing at risk as a major rebate pilot program approaches. This friction impacts supply chain economics, hospital-covered entity pricing, and overall specialty drug cost dynamics that affect self-funded plan management.
articles.source_line: Source: Pharmacy Practice News; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 16:09:24 GMT

articles.title: Family Health Insurance Premiums Exceed $28,000 Amid Rising Worker Contributions
articles.summary: Average annual family health insurance premiums have surpassed $28,000, driven by significant increases in overall healthcare costs and worker contributions. This ongoing cost escalation directly impacts self-funded employers seeking strategies to manage escalating health benefit expenses and employee out-of-pocket burdens.
articles.source_line: Source: Word & Brown General Agency; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 17:50:21 GMT

articles.title: Drug Channels October Roundup Highlights 340B Growth and PBM Wholesale Shifts
articles.summary: The latest industry roundup covers critical developments including the massive expansion of the 340B program footprint and Cigna's strategic push into wholesale drug distribution. These trends directly impact commercial drug pricing dynamics and PBM market strategies that affect self-funded employer health plans.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Channels; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:00:00 GMT

articles.title: Five Years of Data Evaluate Long-Term Cost ROI for GLP-1 Medications
articles.summary: An analysis of five years of data examines whether high-cost GLP-1 weight-loss drugs ultimately pay for themselves through downstream savings. This directly impacts self-funded employers grappling with whether to cover anti-obesity medications and manage skyrocketing plan costs. The findings provide critical context for employers designing pharmacy benefit strategies around specialty drug spend.

articles.title: Employer Plans Drop GLP-1 Coverage Amid Surging Weight-Loss Drug Costs
articles.summary: Growing numbers of employer-sponsored health plans are rolling back or eliminating coverage for GLP-1 weight-loss medications due to unsustainable cost pressures. This trend highlights the critical challenge self-funded employers face in balancing comprehensive benefit offerings with total plan cost management, driving a shift toward alternative obesity management strategies.

articles.title: Scrutiny Mounts Over PBM Pharmacy Reimbursement Practices
articles.summary: Industry reports examine whether major PBMs including CVS, Cigna, and UnitedHealth are penalizing independent pharmacies through unfavorable reimbursement rates and network terms. This ongoing controversy highlights broader market pressures and legislative scrutiny regarding PBM business practices that ultimately impact self-funded employer plan costs and network access.

articles.title: Employers Reconsider PBM Partnerships Amid Rising Drug Costs and Transparency Demands
articles.summary: Employers are increasingly evaluating their pharmacy benefit manager relationships as they seek greater pricing transparency and cost control over escalating prescription drug expenditures. This shift highlights growing frustration with traditional PBM models among self-funded plan sponsors. The trend emphasizes the urgent need for alternative PBM solutions that align with employer financial interests.
articles.source_line: Source: Employee Benefit News; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 19:18:54 GMT

articles.title: Managed Care AI in Pharmacy Outpaces Regulatory Governance
articles.summary: Pharmacy experts warn that artificial intelligence applications in managed care and specialty pharmacy are advancing faster than current governance frameworks. This rapid adoption introduces operational, clinical, and compliance risks for self-funded employers and PBMs managing high-cost specialty drug utilization.
articles.source_line: Source: Specialty Pharmacy Continuum; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 22:00:14 GMT

articles.title: Proactive Copay Assistance Improves Specialty Drug Adherence in Health Plans
articles.summary: Two recent health plan studies demonstrate that proactive copay savings strategies significantly improve patient adherence to specialty medications. For self-funded employers and PBMs, leveraging copay optimization can enhance clinical outcomes and manage the total cost of care for high-cost specialty therapies.
articles.source_line: Source: Specialty Pharmacy Continuum; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 19:01:04 GMT

articles.title: Aon Facing ERISA Lawsuit Over Alleged Employee Benefits Program Profits
articles.summary: Aon has been hit with an ERISA lawsuit alleging it generated improper profits from employee benefits programs. This legal action highlights the increasing fiduciary scrutiny facing brokers and benefits consultants regarding hidden revenue streams, which is of direct strategic importance to self-funded employers managing plan costs.

articles.title: Job-Based Health Plan Costs Rise Amid Continuing Pressures
articles.summary: Employer-sponsored health plan costs continue to climb with little relief expected, driven largely by underlying medical and pharmacy trend factors. This persistent inflation puts mounting pressure on self-funded employers to find aggressive cost-management strategies for their benefit plans. RxBenefits and self-funded plan sponsors must navigate these rising expenses through enhanced PBM contract oversight and utilization management.
articles.source_line: Source: The Miami Times; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 19:29:19 GMT

articles.title: Walgreens Launches GLP-1 Support Services to Navigate Prior Authorization
articles.summary: Walgreens is expanding its pharmacy services to help patients manage GLP-1 therapy through prior authorization support and pharmacist clinical management. For self-funded employers grappling with high GLP-1 utilization and administrative friction, retail pharmacy-led support programs could streamline adherence while requiring alignment with existing PBM utilization management rules.
articles.source_line: Source: Pharmaceutical Commerce; Tue, 27 Oct 2026 18:10:36 GMT
